description: This Java class configures application security using Spring Security 6. It sets up password encoding, authority mapping, an authentication provider, and HTTP security policies including endpoint access restrictions, form login, and logout behavior.

classes.name: ApplicationSecurityConfiguration
classes.description: Main configuration class for setting up Spring Security, including password encoding, authorities mapping, authentication provider, and security filter chain.

methods.name: passwordEncoder
methods.description: Creates a PasswordEncoder bean using BCrypt with strength 11 for encoding user passwords.

methods.name: authoritiesMapper
methods.description: Creates a GrantedAuthoritiesMapper bean that converts authorities to uppercase and defaults to 'USER'.

methods.name: authenticationProvider
methods.description: Configures a DaoAuthenticationProvider with a custom UserDetailsService, password encoder, and authorities mapper.

methods.name: securityFilterChain
methods.description: Defines the main security filter chain: disables CSRF and frame options for H2 console, permits public access to certain endpoints, and secures others, setting up form login and logout procedures.
